messages.subject: Cann't acess my apps on glimmer.rstudio.com/
parts:

An error has occurred

The application failed to start.

The application exited during initialization.

Thanks!

messages.subject: Re: Cann't acess my apps on glimmer.rstudio.com/
parts:
Eduardo,

The issue is that there is a server.R file in your top level (ShinyApps) directory. Shiny Server stops going down the path as soon as it finds the server.R. This is potentially a problem in the Shiny Server, but the workaround for you is to remove that file. I have renamed it to server.R.back, and your app is loading now.

Sorry for the trouble, and we will look into the actual problem.
Fereshteh
